# GCP to AWS Migration Guide

This guide covers migrating your workloads from Google Cloud Platform to Amazon Web Services.

## Service Level Agreements

The service guarantees a minimum throughput of 1000 TPS for standard tier customers.
This SLA applies to all production workloads running on AWS infrastructure.

## Migration Steps

1. Review your current SLA requirements
2. Map to equivalent AWS service tiers
3. Configure your workloads accordingly
